_comment: Select Race's own content. `frame` is the geometry of assets/frame.png, MEASURED off the artwork and cached here - decision 69's arrangement: the image is the authority and tools/smoke_test.py re-measures both rectangles from it and fails on any difference. The numbers are the image's own pixels (it is 1920x1080); screens/select_race/srframe.py scales them to reference space. Work order 132; the assignment and why the other three assets of that set fit nowhere are in doc/briefs/132-frame-assignment.md.

frame._opening_note: The one region of alpha < 16, the same limit tools/frame_holes.py uses. Every box of this screen lies inside it at 1920x1080 and at 2560x1440, which is why this asset was assigned here and to nothing else.
frame._title_plate_note: The widest opaque teal region in the top 15% of the image. The 9-slice drew the screen title in its own title bar; a fixed image has none, so the title is drawn here instead and would otherwise have vanished silently. Next widest candidate in that band is 40 px against this 615, so the rule is not a close call.
